evidence: Embedded FreeEIM at 0x81a3b: main 0x401d60 calls 0x401af0; config is decoded by 0x401a10 and 0x401a60. Config includes a remote controller and service identity.

0x401370 decodes the embedded DLL with a 12-byte cyclic XOR over the first third of its buffer. 0x401af0 writes it, LoadLibraryA loads it, and GetProcAddress resolves MainThread and Install before indirect calls.

Recovered DLL Install at 0x100070d0 calls service installation 0x100044d0, configuring ServiceDll and an svchost group. 0x10005e80 copies the module to a scvhost.exe lookalike and writes the Run value at 0x10005f1b.

Embedded loader at 0x16d04b: startup 0x45a145 decodes bytes at 0x4010f0 using signed key bytes, addition and XOR. 0x45a112 maps the decoded image, resolves Main, and invokes it. The recovered DLL is UPX packed and was separately unpacked for inspection.

Embedded image at 0x37901e contains Microsoft Edge 90.0.818.66 version data, normal MSVC mitigation sections and msedge_elf imports. Its section-name measurements do not establish generated names or malicious behavior.

samples.identification: Salat Go stealer and remote-control implant
evidence: Recovered Go function definitions and disassembly: main.tloop at 0x8e2330 sends requests, decodes returned task data, parses it and calls main.doTask at 0x8e2940.
main.doTask calls downloadFile and starts processes through os/exec; another branch calls executeCommand at 0x8e5730. The websocket shell path at 0x8ca210 starts an OS command with StdinPipe.
main.Steal at 0x8e5be0 enumerates browser profiles, obtains Chromium and Gecko master keys, reads browser data, writes ZIP entries and sends the encoded archive with main.rq.
main.sendScreen at 0x8d2410 calls getScreen at 0x8d2566, Base64 encoding at 0x8d2574, JSON marshaling at 0x8d2676, cryptographic wrapper dec at 0x8d269a and rq at 0x8d26b6. dec uses AES/GCM.
runKeylogger at 0x8d1e30 opens a recording file and installs input hooks. p2pSocks is separately available; its presence does not prove the task loop is transported through SOCKS.
0x401150 creates a target process, allocates remote memory, writes the DLL path, resolves LoadLibraryA and passes it with that path to CreateRemoteThread at 0x40123d.
0x401260 replaces LanmanServer Parameters\ServiceDLL with the dropped StormServer DLL path through RegSetValueExA at 0x40133e.
0x401900 creates an Active Setup component and writes its StubPath at 0x401a4b. Other paths extract the resource DLL and arrange shell self-deletion.

Embedded image at 0x5060 carries StormAttack welcome, DNS and STORM command-format banners. Its zero-filled code/entry regions do not establish a functioning DNS flood in this specimen; the retained trait describes family identity.
